evals.prompt: I have Tesla_Research_CN.html in my report folder with financial_data.json next to it. Generate a complete Tesla_Research_CN.card_slots.json (v2, 4-card schema) beside it, then tell me the exact validate_cards.py and generate_social_cards.py commands with --slots so I get all four PNGs (01_cover, 02_porter, 03_five_year_financials, 04_cfa_lens).
evals.expected_output: Ask which color palette (macaron / default / b / c) before any work; complete v2 card_slots.json (intro_sentence, company_focus_paragraph, metrics_row, industry_paragraph, background_bullets, porter_evidence, five_year_arc, recent_financial_highlights, revenue_explainer_points, cfa_lens); both CLI commands with absolute paths and --brand; generate_social_cards.py must include --palette matching the customer choice; no export without --slots.

evals.prompt: Put the key takeaways from this equity research HTML into the fixed social card slots — same four-card layout as always — and make sure nothing clips before you export.
evals.expected_output: Follows the pipeline (content production for Cards 1–3, then CFA-lens selector for Card 4, then layout fill), full slot JSON v2, validation loop, then render; references design-spec budgets including LIMIT_CARD2_PORTER_EVIDENCE_CHARS and LIMIT_CARD4_* family.

evals.prompt: Batch folder has three *_Research_CN.html files. Each needs its own card_slots.json. How do I pass --input and --slots to validate and render all three?
evals.expected_output: --input directory of HTMLs; --slots as directory containing matching <stem>.card_slots.json per file; no single JSON for unrelated stems.

evals.prompt: Export the four PNGs now — here is the path to my HTML and card_slots.json.
evals.expected_output: Do not run validate/generate until the customer has explicitly chosen macaron, default, b, or c; then pass --palette accordingly on generate_social_cards.py.

evals.prompt: Pick the Card 4 CFA concept for this NVIDIA report. I'm currently studying Level 2 Fixed Income / binomial tree. Build the cfa_lens block.
evals.expected_output: Reads --cfa-progress / CFA_PROGRESS env / USER.md sticky; pick binomial tree if it maps to NVDA (state-contingent payoffs for inference vs training scenarios) or default to a more equity-relevant L2 concept (real options for NVDA) if binomial tree is a poor fit; justify why the chosen concept maps to THIS company; fill concept_intro, company_application (≥3 bullets with mapped variables + numbers), different_angle_insight (must include primary_quote from CFO/CEO/filing), takeaway; record cfa_progress_source.
